notes.title: 2nd September 2025 update
notes.notes: All tables now have improved Plunger control when the ball is launched with the Return key. If you also hold down the Ctrl key, the Plunger moves more slowly, allowing for more precise control of the launch moment, and thus the ball's speed.

notes.title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom June 2025 update
notes.notes:
• Gameroom’s Navigator can show table names instead of icons (via radiobutton in Preferences)
• You can mark your favorite tables in the Navigator. In Preferences you may check the checkbox to show only your favorites.
• Added a treshold slider for Game Controller’s plunger.
• Some bug fixes for Bally Big Time and Bally Variety.

[b]Did you know?[/b]
For people who like to play Bingos to the max: you don’t have to keep the N or X button pressed until you're satisfied with the odds and features level. Press Shift+N to keep the machine going, until another button is pressed. Shift+X repeats until an Extra Ball is granted.

notes.title: All Tables now support Game Controllers
notes.notes:
All Tables are upgraded to version 5.0. What has changed:
• All Tables now support Game Controllers
• You may use Shift+N or Shift+X to avoid constantly pressing N or X button
